background.description: White paper, black ink, running/cursive handwriting (not block, capital, or disjointed letters)

notes: Verified against the official CEN 09/2025 detailed notification (para 16.5.1): signature scanned at minimum 100 DPI, JPG/JPEG only, 30-49 KB, minimum 140x60 pixels, black ink pen on white paper, in running/cursive handwriting (block, capital, or disjointed letters are rejected). This CEN also confirms candidates are NOT required to upload a pre-existing photograph — the application module captures a live photograph via webcam or mobile front camera during form-filling instead, so there is no rrb-group-d-photo preset.
